versions.changelog: 可发现性优化：topics 补微信读书/读书笔记；内容零变更
discoverability fix - topics 换入 3 个中文零竞争词(阅读记忆/跨书/读书伴侣); 内容零变更, No behavior change.
displayName 改为中文，打开「微信读书」等中文检索面

Rewrites the storefront and Skill documentation for clearer GEO entity recognition, offline reading-memory queries, explicit activation boundaries, canonical examples, and machine-readable metadata while preserving the v1.4.0 single-file, Read-only runtime.

Reader Memory v2 adds user-confirmed supports, conflicts, extends, and exemplifies relations, local non-persistent suggestions, an offline dual-book demo, continue-thinking return flow, and user-triggered Markdown/Canvas PNG cards while preserving the v1.3.3 single-file, no-network, Read-only architecture.
Single-file offline Socratic reading core using only user-pasted passages and in-conversation summaries.
Rebuilt as a fully offline static reading coach with user-pasted excerpts, explicit language choice, local browser memory, and no server, credentials, or network access.
Security hardening: session-only credentials, per-request consent, foreground-only server lifecycle, strict API validation, and bilingual language behavior.

Security-reviewed Reader Memory release: removed child-process browser launch and shell-profile credential discovery, replaced bundled Mermaid with auditable local rendering, split frontend assets, added explicit data consent and one-time bulk-delete confirmation.
v1.2.0: 接入个人划线/想法(热门↔我的切换)、流式对话输出、刷新会话恢复、读书小结生成、笔记导出带出处元数据并按章节分组、修复 /book/chapterinfo 白名单缺失导致的搜索403、错误处理与状态收敛重构
XSS 加固：所有 innerHTML 拼接处 escapeHtml 转义；Mermaid securityLevel 改为 antiscript（禁用图表内脚本）；SKILL.md metadata 显式声明 network 与 filesystem 范围；server.js skill_version 升级
安全加固：服务仅监听 127.0.0.1；execFile 替代 exec 拼接；API 白名单字段级过滤；start.sh 不再 source rc 文件，改用 PID 文件管理进程；Mermaid 本地化；新增隐私说明与清除 Key 功能
安全加固版：exec 改为 execFile 参数数组；去掉通配 CORS，/api/weread 增加 api_name 与字段白名单；启动脚本不再 source shell rc 文件，改为静态提取 WEREAD_API_KEY，且只停止本应用进程；Mermaid 本地打包加载；设置弹窗增加隐私说明与一键清除 Key；导出笔记增加版权提醒；补充 skill-card.md

weread-socrates 1.0.0 初始发布。

- 首次发布本地 Web 应用版 AI 伴读 · 苏格拉底式阅读教练
- 集成微信读书 API，支持搜书、全书结构思维导图（非虚构/虚构自动识别）、万人热门划线、多选段落
- 提供 5 轮苏格拉底式引导对话，支持对划线内容深度互动
- 支持 Markdown 笔记导出
- 明确本地启动流程、依赖检查及常见问题排查指南

- Initial release of weread-socrates: an AI-powered local web app integrating with WeRead API for deep reading support.
- Supports book search, automatic full-book mindmap/persona graph generation, multi-selection of popular highlights, Socratic 5-round guided dialogue, and Markdown note export.
- Step-by-step local setup process, requiring Node.js and API keys for WeRead and large model providers (GLM, DeepSeek).
- Robust troubleshooting guidance for common startup and usage issues.
- Designed for local machine use only; guides users to transfer and run locally if not already in a suitable environment.
